title: Septic Service Follow-Up Visit Checklist Form
subtitle: Control site assessment, safe access, inspection, pumping, maintenance, transport, and handoff through verified identity, domain-specific observations, evidence, authorization, exception ownership, and accountable closeout.
description: An original, workflow-complete septic service follow-up visit checklist for tanks, baffles, pumps, controls, distribution components, and drainfield observations. It connects system records, approved scope, and disposal authority to present conditions, repeatable evidence, decisions, unresolved work, and the receiving party's handoff.
use_case: Use when a qualified septic-service technician must compare a current septic service condition with prior service evidence, decide whether it is planned, recurring, incomplete, or new, and assign the next action.

blocks.guidance: This septic service follow-up visit checklist is an operational record, not a substitute for applicable law, licensing, product labeling, manufacturer instructions, site policy, safety requirements, or professional judgment. Stop affected work, access, application, operation, testing, or release when tank access, collapse, confined-space, toxic or flammable atmosphere, sewage exposure, buried utility, pumping, transport, disposal, or system condition is uncertain. A septic, wastewater, or safety supervisor must review the exception, authorize the controlling decision, and preserve its evidence before closeout.
